author: Philip J. Corso (with William J. Birnes)
credibility_assessment: CONTESTED - Contains verifiable factual errors and chronological impossibilities

claims.claim: US Government recovered alien spacecraft from Roswell in 1947 and reverse-engineered its technology
claims.supporting_evidence: Author's testimony only; no corroborating physical evidence
claims.critical_notes: Core claim of the book with no independent verification

claims.claim: Corso personally saw body of extraterrestrial in shipping crate at Fort Riley, Kansas in 1947
As Chief of Pentagon's Foreign Technology Division (1960-1962), Corso seeded alien technology into American industry including IBM, Hughes Aircraft, Bell Labs, Dow Corning
claims.supporting_evidence: Corso did serve in Foreign Technology Division briefly
claims.critical_notes: Critics note Corso lacked science/engineering degree; technology origins have conventional explanations

claims.claim: Technologies reverse-engineered from alien craft include: integrated circuits, night vision, lasers, Kevlar, fiber optics, smart metals
claims.supporting_evidence: Technologies exist; alien origin claim unsubstantiated
claims.critical_notes: Conventional development histories exist for all named technologies

claims.claim: Corso served on Eisenhower's National Security Council (1953-1957)
claims.supporting_evidence: Military records confirm NSC staff service

claims.claim: Book attributes central heroic role to Corso in Cuban Missile Crisis, JFK assassination investigation, outing KGB spies in CIA
claims.supporting_evidence: No historical records found confirming Corso's involvement in these events
claims.critical_notes: Skeptical Inquirer review (Brad Sparks) found no historical support

documented_errors: Misidentified 8th Air Force HQ as Fort Bliss instead of Fort Worth AAF
Misdated Walter Haut's Roswell press release
Erroneously described MIM-23 Hawk as heat-seeking (it's radar-guided)
Multiple chronological impossibilities noted by analysts

critical_assessments.philip_klass: Challenged multiple claims as factually unbelievable
critical_assessments.brad_sparks: No historical record of Corso's involvement in claimed seminal events
critical_assessments.general_consensus: Large number of errors about basic, known facts

relevance_to_sherlock.notes: Represents influential UAP disclosure narrative regardless of veracity. Claims about technology seeding to defense contractors relevant to understanding reverse-engineering allegations in UAP disclosure.
